evals.name: flaky-test
evals.prompt: Add an icon for a flaky test (a test that passes and fails without a code change) to this icon set, ready to ship.
evals.expected_output: Before drawing: a semantic brief in chat (meaning in product words, where it is used, the shape, what else that shape reads as, who may read it differently, nearest icons in the set, implied siblings, alternatives, name and group) and a stop for confirmation. After confirmation: a 14x14 fill-only SVG built from a named exemplar, a contact sheet the agent looked at, component + story + index export + iconList entry + minor changeset written by add.mjs, type-check passing, and a delivery note with the remaining readings and the Figma gap.

evals.name: status-skipped
evals.prompt: We need a StatusSkipped icon to go with StatusPass/StatusFail/StatusWarn.
evals.expected_output: A brief that names the Status glyph family and its box, confirms what 'skipped' means to the team (not run vs. ignored vs. pending), checks collisions with StatusIcon (the plain dot) and StatusRemoveIcon; then a glyph in the same box as its siblings, rendered beside them, wired into the Communicate group next to the other Status icons.

evals.name: update-bell
evals.prompt: Make the BellIcon's clapper a bit bigger, it disappears at 14px.
evals.expected_output: A brief that says what changes and that the meaning does not; an export of the current BellIcon SVG; an edit that keeps the icon's family and introduces no new rule break; a before/after render looked at 14px; add.mjs --replace writing only the TSX plus a patch changeset; a delivery note that the Figma component must be updated or the next regenerate reverts the change.

evals.name: draft-story
evals.prompt: Add an icon for a draft story, one that is not yet published to the team.
evals.expected_output: A brief that confirms what 'draft' means here (unpublished, unfinished or hidden), where it sits (beside the story name in the sidebar, or a badge) and whether a 'published' twin is implied; a check that nothing in the set already means draft (DocumentIcon, EditIcon and EyeCloseIcon are the neighbours); a stop for confirmation; then an icon in the family the place implies, rendered beside those neighbours and wired in. No reference file pre-answers this request.
